ops.text: cc-notes Stop hook nudge_investigation_stop_sweep (plugin 0.71.0, capt-hook/hooks/record.py) blocked a stop with 'An investigation opened this session has no verdict yet. Close it with cc-notes investigation root-cause <id>' after I had already run root-cause on 6693ed9 and its status was root_caused. The hook's own logic only clears an id on confirm, exonerate, or abandon (INVESTIGATION_TERMINAL_VERBS) and re-arms it on root_cause, so the command the message prescribes cannot satisfy it. From root_caused the CLI allows only fix --commit, reopen, exonerate, abandon; a red CI run whose cause is an external race with no fixing commit has no truthful terminal verb, since exonerate means the premise was false and abandon means no verdict. I left it root_caused with a follow-up task.
